activities.title: Workday AI in Software Engineering Lifecycle
activities.description: Attended technical sessions exploring the integration of AI tools, LLMs, and intelligent automation across the software development lifecycle.

activities.title: Google European University Challenge
activities.description: Competed in a Europe-wide university challenge solving Google Cloud courses and challenges. Demonstrating proficiency in cloud computing and problem-solving skills.

activities.title: Mastercard Ireland Intern Hackathon - 1st Place Winner
activities.description: Designed and developed “MATA”, Mastercard Travel Assistant, an AI powered travel assistant in a 5-person team. Presented a demo to a panel of Mastercard executives, demonstrating its potential for enhancing customer experience.

activities.title: HackIreland
activities.description: Collaborated in a 4-person team at a two-day hackathon sponsored by top tech companies like Intercom, OpenAI, Stripe and Tines. Engineered a prototype for a web application that leveraged AI to analyse brand safety and facilitate funding for online creators.

activities.title: PyCon Ireland
activities.description: Attended sessions highlighting various uses of python and its libraries and frameworks. Gained insights into best practices and emerging trends in the Python community.
